title: fix(app-shell): the Home app tiles are links, so an app opens in a new tab and its address can be copied (objectui#12305)
body:
Fixes #12305
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The "Your apps" tiles on console Home were buttons whose `onClick` called `navigate()`, so an app had no address. Middle-click and ⌘/Ctrl-click did nothing extra, the context menu offered no "Open link in new tab" or "Copy link address", and hovering showed no destination.

- `HomeAppsStrip` renders each app tile as a react-router `Link` to `/apps/SEGMENT`, keeping its classes and `data-testid`. Per ADR-0048, SEGMENT is the app's package id, or its name when it has none. `Link` writes the router basename into `href`, so the address the browser opens or copies is the real one: `/_console/apps/SEGMENT` under the console mount. A plain left-click still navigates in place. A modified or non-primary click is left to the browser.
- The strip owns the address rule. Its `onOpen` prop is removed, together with the copy of the rule each of its two mounts carried: `HomePage`, and the `app:launcher` block in `app-launcher-renderer.tsx`, which no longer needs `useNavigate`. The dropped `?? app.name` was dead code, because `appRouteSegment` already falls back to the name.
- "More", "Show less" and the marketplace shortcut stay buttons, because they open nothing addressable. A test pins this.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

Clause-② is `no`. `HomeAppsStrip` and `AppLauncherRenderer` cannot be reached from the package entry. On the built package, `dist/index.d.ts` names each of them 0 times, against 1 for the control `HomePage`. The `exports` map exposes only `.` and `./styles.css`. `HomePage`'s props are unchanged.

## Tests

New: `HomeAppsStrip.tilesAreLinks-12305.test.tsx`, a real render inside a `MemoryRouter` with basename `/_console`:
- Each tile has `role=link`. Its `href` is `/_console/apps/crm` for an app with only a name, and `/_console/apps/com.acme.ops` for an app with a package id.
- The tile cancels a plain left-click, and the router moves to `/apps/com.acme.ops`.
- ⌘, Ctrl, Shift, Alt and middle-button clicks are not cancelled, and the router stays put.
- "More", "Show less" and the marketplace shortcut are `BUTTON` elements.

Extended: `phase1-page-blocks.render.test.tsx` now also asserts that the `app:launcher` tile is a link with `href` `/apps/ops`.

Fixture triage, measured on a first run rather than predicted. Seven HomePage suites stub `react-router-dom` with a hand-listed factory that exports only `useNavigate`. Every case in them that rendered a tile died on `No "Link" export is defined on the "react-router-dom" mock`, for 44 failed and 99 passed across 23 files. Each factory now also exports a `Link` stand-in that renders the plain anchor, without the basename. None of the seven asserts tile behaviour. They are `aiStudioDisabled`, `approvalsTarget`, `authoringCapabilityGate`, `greetingLocale-11689`, `inboxLinksTarget`, `marketplaceDisabled` and `notificationDeepLink`. `AppSwitcher.appIdentity-12201`, from the dispatch's list of leads, matches only the `--os-app-tile-bg` CSS variable and does not render the strip.

Ablation, in two legs. Each was restored and proven: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
1. The three source files checked out at the base: 4 failed, namely 3 of the 8 strip cases plus the launcher href. The five modified-click cases stayed green. The base button calls an `onOpen` that the test never passes, so a click does nothing and this leg cannot tell those cases apart.
2. The tile as a button that navigates, which is the real pre-fix behaviour, written with `ablation-replace.mjs` in five anchored edits: 9 failed, namely all 8 strip cases plus the launcher href. A first attempt at this leg was refused by the tool, because one replacement still contained its own anchor, and the tool restored the file. No test ran on that attempt.

## Verification, at `26e52e0`

- Build: `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` gave 28/28. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build` passed. The console `vite build` ran for the bundle gates.
- vitest on `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/`, `phase1-page-blocks.render.test.tsx` and `exclusion-reason-truthfulness.test.ts`: 23 files, 143 tests passed.
- Router-mocking suites that can reach a tile: 6 files, 110 tests passed. These are every test that mocks `react-router-dom` and names the app-shell entry, `HomePage`, the strip, the launcher or a registry sweep, plus `appRoute.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exited 0. It echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` on the test project lists all 12 touched TS files.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 12 touched files, each `isPathIgnored: false` by eslint's own API: 0 errors and 17 warnings, all pre-existing `no-explicit-any`. The same files at the base give 19 warnings; the two that went are the `any`-typed `onOpen` prop and callback. Type-aware linting is off and no rule reads other files, so this diff cannot change the verdict on an untouched file.
- Gates, each exit 0:
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`
  - `check:sdui-registration-pins`: 15 registrations, including `launcher`.
  - `check:eager-closure`: 3132.6 KB against a 3204.6 KB budget.
- Not run locally, left to CI: the full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

I measured the base button tile and the new anchor tile in Chromium against the console's built stylesheet, in light and dark. Both had the same classes and inner markup.
- Look: geometry (the tile, icon and label boxes), colours, font, padding and radius are identical. The hover screenshots are byte-identical. At rest, about 176 of 12,972 pixels differ by at most 1/255 per channel, which is rasterisation noise; a one-character label change does register as a difference.
- Cursor: `default` becomes `pointer`, the usual link affordance.
- Press: the console theme's unlayered `button:not([disabled])` rule ("iOS-style press springback" in `apps/console/src/index.css`) gave the button tile `transform: scale(.96)`. That applied on top of the tile's own `active:scale-[0.96]`, which Tailwind v4 writes as the separate `scale` property, so a held button tile shrank to 0.96 × 0.96 = 0.9216. The rule matches buttons only, so the link tile presses with its own declared classes: `scale` 0.96 with the 150 ms `transition` utility. The hover background now fades over 150 ms; under the rule's transition list it snapped. The report records this as an open question, and this PR makes no theme change.
- Keyboard: a link activates on Enter only, and Space scrolls. That is standard link behaviour.
- Same-location click: react-router's `Link` replaces the history entry instead of pushing when the target equals the current location, for example the `app:launcher` block on a page inside the app a tile names. `navigate()` pushed a duplicate entry.
- The same shape exists elsewhere and is left alone here:
  - `console/home/AppCard.tsx` opens an app through an overlay button, but nothing in the tree renders it.
  - The header's hidden-apps menu and the app switcher open apps from menu items. `AppHeader.tsx` is fenced to the objectui#12295 work.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`.
